terms.meaning: Browser memory that lasts while one tab stays open and is cleared when the tab closes.
A reference to the saved evidence that supports a statement.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Header comment and imports
sections.what: The header explains the purpose and limits of the note. The imports bring in the state tool and the lightbulb and close icons.
sections.why: The comment sets the rules: the note names a saved finding and never implies live processing.

sections.name: DemoHintData
sections.title: Shape of one hint
sections.what: Defines what a hint holds: a unique id, the spot it attaches to, an optional slide or tab name, the text, and an optional citation with project and evidence references.
sections.why: Likely reason: the citation fields point back to the saved evidence behind the finding.
sections.watch_out: The id must be unique, because it is used both to show the note and to remember dismissals.

sections.name: readDismissed
sections.title: Reading dismissed hints from storage
sections.what: Returns the list of hint ids dismissed in this tab session, or an empty list if nothing is saved or the saved data cannot be read.
sections.why: Likely reason: a failed read should not stop the page from showing.
sections.watch_out: Saved data is accepted as a list without checking its contents, so manual edits in browser storage could cause odd behavior.

sections.name: DemoHint
sections.title: The note itself
sections.what: Shows the note unless it has been dismissed. The close button saves the id and hides the note. The citation button appears only when both a citation and a callback are provided.
sections.why: Likely reason: a small removable note that never blocks the control it sits beside.
sections.watch_out: Whether the note is hidden is decided once when it first appears, so a hint dismissed in another tab still shows here until this view is refreshed.

sections.name: hintsAt
sections.title: Picking hints for one spot
sections.what: Returns the hints that match a spot. Slide hints with no slide name apply to every slide. Tab hints need the matching tab name. Other spots match on the spot alone. Returns an empty list when there are no hints.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets one hint cover every slide while still targeting specific tabs when needed.
sections.watch_out: A slide hint with no slide name shows on every slide, so it may repeat across the whole replay.

summary: A small dismissible note placed beside a control in a demo replay, with an optional button that opens its supporting evidence.
purpose: Points the viewer to a finding saved with the pinned demo run, without adding screens or implying that anything is running live.
why: The header comment states the rule: the note never adds a screen, a step strip, or implies live running.
how: Given a hint with a place to attach it, the page selects the hints for that spot. Each hint shows a note with its text and an optional Open citation button. Dismissing hides the note and saves its id in session storage, so it stays hidden for the rest of the browser tab session.
inputs: Hint data (id, the spot it attaches to, optional slide or tab name, text, and an optional citation), and a callback for opening a citation.
outputs: A note on screen, a call to the citation callback when its button is pressed, and a session storage entry listing dismissed hint ids.
risks: Dismissed hint ids stay hidden for the whole tab session, so an edited hint will not return until the tab is closed. Hints with the same id share one dismissal. If browser storage is blocked, dismissing only lasts while that view stays open.
debug: If a hint does not appear, check its attachment spot and the slide or tab name used in the matching helper. If a fixed hint still does not return, clear the session storage entry or open a new tab. If Open citation does nothing, check the callback passed in by the parent.
